observed_no_compression_frontier.theorem_like_statement: For the observed P35 finite design, every strict coordinate projection of (C,S,P,L,D) identifies at least one pair of conditions with different 32-bit geometry. Therefore no nontrivial coordinate-projection sufficient statistic exists for the full geometry.

interpretation: Within the currently measured pre-response coordinate system, exact behavioral geometry is effectively saturated: context plus all four construction coordinates are jointly necessary for full-row determination, while identifier-package changes introduce an additional full-rank matched-profile perturbation. This is an observational finite-design boundary, not a universal impossibility theorem.
